replication.target_description: ABC Support practice-based replication, randomized multiple-baseline design across four Grade 2 students; row-specific outcome/test unresolved.

notes: Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. No original primary source was assigned or consulted. Page 8 has distinct baseline-versus-intervention tests: training WCPM average bias-corrected g = 3.59, p = .042; non-training WCPM average g = 2.06, p = .25. Both also have follow-up comparisons (g = 2.88 and 1.50, respectively; each p = .042). The supplied outcome description does not choose among outcomes; no mapping by row order or numeric matching was made. Common design sample candidate is four students, directly stated, not derived from degrees of freedom; repeated observations are not participant N. This candidate is retained only for parent field-scope review. All four referred students met screening criteria (section 4.2); no participant exclusion from the four-student critical design is described. The generic intervention-name description also does not identify the phase contrast.
